meta.name: House of Guinness
meta.description: Dublin, 1868. The Guinness family patriarch is dead, and his four children — each with dark secrets to hide — hold the brewery's fate in their hands.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: It's the day of Sir Benjamin Lee Guinness' funeral. Trouble is brewing on the streets of Dublin, while his children make plans for the family's future.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The will leaves two siblings with everything, two with nothing — and all of them dissatisfied. Rafferty makes threats and receives one himself.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Anne suffers a traumatic carriage ride. Arthur makes a proposal, Edward makes changes within the brewery and Benjamin decides to strike out on his own.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: All of Dublin society attends Arthur's wedding — including two faces he wasn't expecting. Benjamin steps up for Edward, and the expansion plan begins.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: When Arthur's political career implodes, Rafferty helps comfort his wife. Byron makes a promise that could make or break the Guinness family.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A desperate Ellen asks Edward for help. On a trip to Cloonboo, Adelaide sees him in a new light and Arthur resolves to be more involved in the brewery.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Work gets started on the new social housing. Edward and Arthur agree to resist their own desires and do what's best for the brewery — and the family.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: As election day approaches, a familiar face returns to Dublin. Arthur remains steadfast with his campaign — despite the looming danger.
